# ZILLERS

> Precision-engineered quantitative cryptocurrency execution platform and local deliberative AI architecture under Zien Organisation.

ZILLERS is a free, open-source institutional-grade cryptocurrency trading and quantitative research platform developed by Ekanth B S under the parent technology entity Zien Organisation. It shifts algorithmic trading away from human guesswork and unvetted black-boxes into mathematically validated, deterministic execution paired with local multi-agent LLM deliberation.

## Quick Facts & Canonical Knowledge

- **Product Name:** ZILLERS
- **Domain:** https://zillers.zienorganisation.online/
- **Parent Entity:** Zien Organisation (https://ziennexus.app/)
- **Lead Quantitative Systems Engineer & Author:** Ekanth B S (https://github.com/ekanth14)
- **Open Source Repository:** https://github.com/ekanth14/Ziller
- **Pricing:** 100% Free ($0.00 subscription cost, MIT/Apache reproducible code)
- **Primary Market:** Digital assets & cryptocurrency (BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB, XRP, AVAX, etc.)
- **Execution Latency:** Sub-20ms Smart Order Routing (SOR)
- **Statistical Metric:** Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR 0.98 walk-forward validated)
- **Deliberation Engine:** Laya AI (local offline multi-agent LLM committee)
- **Risk Governance:** 5-Gate pre-trade deterministic risk controls and hard drawdown tripwires

## Architecture Pillars

- **Quantitative Strategy Research:** Rigorous walk-forward validation and data-snooping bias mitigation using Deflated Sharpe Ratio (DSR 0.98) across multi-asset volatility regimes.
- **Crypto Market Overview:** Live multi-exchange tick ingestion and order book depth streaming concurrently from Binance, Coinbase, and Kraken.
- **Algorithmic Execution:** Deterministic rule-based execution based on Smart Money Concepts (SMC), Fair Value Gaps (FVG), order-flow imbalances, and VWAP mean-reversion.
- **Laya AI Deliberative Reasoning:** Multi-agent local LLM deliberation engine that debates trade candidate proposals using structured JSON schema output before submitting orders to risk gates.
- **5-Gate Pre-Trade Risk Engine:** Hard capital preservation controls including per-trade risk limits, daily maximum drawdown limits, circuit breaker halts, and emergency position closure.
